text: My baggage has not arrived and I have waited two hours.
The flight was delayed and I missed my connecting flight.
The security queue was too long and moving very slowly.
The restroom near gate 12 was dirty and needed cleaning.
A staff member at check-in counter 4 was rude when I asked for assistance.
The food served at the terminal restaurant was cold and of poor quality.
Parking fees are expensive and finding a spot took thirty minutes.
The taxi shuttle arrived very late and I waited nearly forty minutes.
Thank you so much to the ground team for being quick and helpful.
Great experience at security today fast screening and polite staff.
